description: Deterministic bounded profile of Dhrystone 2.1's core record, string, array, Proc, and Func workload; not an official Dhrystone score.

output.encoding: 19 unsigned one-byte fields in order: Int_Glob, Bool_Glob, Ch_1_Glob, Ch_2_Glob, Arr_1_Glob[8], Arr_2_Glob[8][7], Ptr_Glob discr/enum/int/pointer-index, Next_Ptr_Glob discr/enum/int/pointer-index, Int_1_Loc, Int_2_Loc, Int_3_Loc, Enum_Loc, Func_2_false_flag

workspace.meaning: Staged fixed-size summary of final global, array, record, and local values.

profile.initialization: Two zero-initialized records with Ptr_Glob pointing to Next_Ptr_Glob; Arr_2_Glob[8][7] starts at 10; fixed Dhrystone 2.1 strings are copied into bounded 31-byte buffers.
profile.loop: Execute the source's ordered per-pass sequence Proc_5, Proc_4, Func_2, the Int_1_Loc loop/Proc_7, Proc_8, Proc_1, the Ch_Index/Func_1 loop with Proc_6 branch, integer arithmetic, and Proc_2. The run index starts at one.
profile.scope_note: This fixed-pass deterministic core profile omits timing, CLI parsing, and the full benchmark reporting wrapper. It must not be reported as an official Dhrystone score.

notice.attribution: Dhrystone 2.1 by Reinhold P. Weicker (1988); this packaged source states public-domain status, including its 2022 ANSI C modifications by nfinit.
